subject: skill/run-workflow/emit-scope-split
claim: The self-build emit paths resolve scope differently: _emit_self_finding writes into the cell's own scope via cell_scope(wd) = self-<worktree> (workflow_runner.py:1842-1847), while _emit_research_report uses rag_params['emit_scope'] when non-empty, falling back to cell_scope (workflow_runner.py:1943); an emit_scope of agentic-dynamics therefore lands the research-report record in the shared org scope, never the cell scope.
